This is a list of video games for the original [[PlayStation (console)|PlayStation]] [[video game console]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. The best-selling game on the PlayStation is ''[[Gran Turismo (1997 video game)|Gran Turismo]]''. A [[sim racing]] game developed by [[Polyphony Digital]], ''Gran Turismo'' was originally released in Japan on December 23, 1997, and went on to sell 10.85{{nbsp}}million units worldwide.<ref name="granturismo">{{cite news |url=http://www.pcworld.com/article/145675/article.html |title=Gran Turismo Series Shipments Hit 50 Million |last=Williams |first=Martyn |work=[[PC World]] |publisher=[[International Data Group|IDG]] |date=May 9, 2008 |access-date=May 2, 2017 |archive-date=May 5, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505142105/https://www.pcworld.com/article/145675/article.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> The second-best-selling game on the console is ''[[Final Fantasy VII]]'' (1997), which sold over 10{{nbsp}}million units.<ref name="ff7"/>{{efn|name="FF7"}} The top five is rounded out by ''[[Gran Turismo 2]]'' (1999) with 9.37{{nbsp}}million units sold,<ref name="granturismo"/> ''[[Final Fantasy VIII]]'' (1999) selling 8.6{{nbsp}}million units,<ref name="FFVIII"/> and ''[[Tekken 3]]'' (1998) with 8.3{{nbsp}}million units sold.<ref name="tekken3">{{cite web |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/how-tekken-7s-arcade-roots-are-shaping-its-console/1100-6447149/ |title=How Tekken 7's Arcade Roots Are Shaping Its Console Form |last=Tran |first=Edmond |work=[[GameSpot]] |publisher=[[CBS Interactive]] |date=January 23, 2017 |access-date=May 2, 2017 |archive-date=August 30, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200830173451/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/how-tekken-7s-arcade-roots-are-shaping-its-console/1100-6447149/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

There are a total of 127 PlayStation games on this list which are confirmed to have sold or shipped at least one million units. Of these, 49 were published in one or more regions by [[Sony Computer Entertainment]]. Other publishers with multiple million-selling games include [[Namco]] with twelve games, [[Square (video game company)|Square]] with ten games, [[Eidos Interactive]] with eight games, [[Konami]] and [[Electronic Arts]] with seven games each, and [[Capcom]] with six games. The developers with the most million-selling games include Namco with eleven games, Square with ten games, Konami and Sony Computer Entertainment with seven games each, and Capcom with six games. The most popular franchises on the PlayStation include ''[[Crash Bandicoot]]'' (27.43{{nbsp}}million combined units), ''[[Final Fantasy]]'' ({{nowrap|26.39 million}} combined units), ''[[Tomb Raider]]'' (25.9{{nbsp}}million combined units), ''[[Gran Turismo (series)|Gran Turismo]]'' (20.22{{nbsp}}million combined units), and ''[[Tekken]]'' ({{nowrap|15.73 million}} combined units). The oldest game on this list is ''[[Ridge Racer (1993 video game)|Ridge Racer]]'', first released on the platform on December 3, 1994, while the most recent is ''[[Dancing Stage Party Edition]]'', released on November 15, 2002, when the [[PlayStation 2]] had been out for more than two years.

As of March 2007, a total of 962{{nbsp}}million copies of PlayStation software had been shipped worldwide.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.scei.co.jp/corporate/data/bizdatapssoft_e.html |title=Cumulative Production Shipments of Software Titles |publisher=[[Sony Computer Entertainment]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080923062826/http://www.scei.co.jp/corporate/data/bizdatapssoft_e.html |archive-date=September 23, 2008 |access-date=May 2, 2017 }}</ref>
